notes.title: Demo Out Now!
notes.content: [p][b]The demo for [i]The Greenening[/i] is now live![/b][/p][p]Dive into a wholesome incremental journey where you control a fluffy cloud, raining down on a forgotten planet. Discover the secrets hidden beneath the ashes and bring the world back to life. 🌱[/p][p]It also features tons of upgrades, a cute character by the name of Sparkle and a cozy idle space garden.[/p][previewyoutube="zR0s6GCD534;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]Play the demo and wishlist the full game now![/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634980/The_Greenening_Demo"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support - your feedback truly helps in shaping the full game! 💚[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Erkberg[/p]

notes.title: Running well on Steam Deck!
notes.content: [p]The Greenening will be playable on Steam Deck![/p][p]Here's a quick video of that:[/p][previewyoutube="78c-VYbQp4A;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Both stick and touchpad controls work quite well and it runs smoothly.[/p][p]I love playing games on the Deck myself, so I'll make sure that it stays that way for the full release next year.[/p][p]The demo is releasing tomorrow (Sep 09, 7pm CEST), so it's not long until you can try it out for yourself :)[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Erkberg[/p]

notes.title: Quick development update
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone! Here's a quick update on the development progress of the game so far and what's up next.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm currently working on making the game fully playable, which means adding lots of content, gameplay mechanics and visuals to it. It's going well and the content is about 50% finished. Here's a sneak peek at one of the areas from the middle of the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469078/1b75296d08ca19b0d78e435ef84694c2d4713e8b.png"][/img][/p][p]There's also a free demo planned to be released in August 2025. This one is already fully playable, but needs some more fine-tuning and polishing touches to really shine, which I'm also working on :)[/p][p][/p][p]It's been a bit quiet around here since the announcement of the game a few months back, but I'll make sure to share some progress updates and infos about the game more regularly from now on. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot for your interest and support![/p][p]Erkberg[/p]

notes.title: A new journey begins ...
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
I'm Erik aka Erkberg and super excited to announce my second game here on Steam.
The Greenening is a short incremental game about rediscovering and growing life in a forlorn world.

[previewyoutube=yqKcDesxI-U;full][/previewyoutube]
Development of the game is still in an early stage, so look forward to a lot of updates.
Every bit of feedback along the way is highly appreciated!

Thanks a lot for checking out my game,
Erik
